scan_type: CT trauma (whole body; limited head and cervical spine variant)

paragraphs.name: Technique
paragraphs.normal_text: Non-contrast CT head and cervical spine, followed by contrast-enhanced CT chest, abdomen and pelvis (split-bolus arterial/portal venous phase). Multiplanar bone reformats.

paragraphs.name: Head
paragraphs.normal_text:
Head:
No intracranial haemorrhage or extra-axial collection. No midline shift. No skull vault or skull base fracture. Grey-white differentiation preserved.

paragraphs.name: Cervical spine
paragraphs.normal_text:
Cervical spine:
No acute fracture or malalignment of the cervical spine. Craniocervical junction intact. Prevertebral soft tissues not thickened.

paragraphs.name: Chest
paragraphs.normal_text:
Chest:
No pneumothorax or haemothorax. No pulmonary contusion or laceration. Mediastinum not widened; no mediastinal haematoma and no traumatic aortic injury. No rib, sternal or clavicular fracture.

paragraphs.name: Abdomen
paragraphs.normal_text:
Abdomen:
No solid organ injury. No free fluid or free gas. Kidneys enhance symmetrically; no perinephric haematoma. Adrenals unremarkable.

paragraphs.name: Pelvis
paragraphs.normal_text:
Pelvis:
Pelvic ring intact. No pelvic haematoma. Bladder unremarkable.

paragraphs.name: Thoracolumbar spine
paragraphs.normal_text:
Thoracolumbar spine:
No thoracolumbar spinal fracture. Alignment maintained.

paragraphs.name: Other
paragraphs.normal_text: (optional; present only when there is something to say, e.g. example 01 seatbelt soft-tissue contusion)

paragraphs.name: Conclusion
paragraphs.normal_text:
1. No acute traumatic injury identified.

Preliminary findings relayed to the trauma team leader in CT at {time}.
